adaptation_boundaries: The task is an offline deterministic core-SDK adaptation; no live API, credentials, or external service is used.
Generated endpoint resources, Azure/Bedrock providers, realtime websockets, TLS/mTLS, file uploads, and optional transports are outside the frozen contract.
HTTP behavior is exercised only with an injected in-memory httpx2 transport through the child-side JSON adapter.
Candidate code is imported only in an unprivileged subprocess; trusted verifier tests never import candidate modules.
